Speaker confirmations have not been supplied. The two workshop directories are therefore presented as provisional lists. Public profiles are linked from every name and portrait.

The banner traces a simulated Hodgkin–Huxley action potential on five staff lines. Model and source notes · Simulation data

The ICE/FIRE brush circle is an original generated illustration. The quotation, “Music is rhythmic. So is life.”, is from Rodolphe’s Clocks and Rhythms (2022).
